rationale: TLK has gapped up 8.13% with no news catalyst identified, which creates significant uncertainty about the driver and sustainability of the move. Price is at 93.6% of today's range near the session high with extremely tight 1-minute candles showing volume collapsing (from 122,500 to under 5,000), suggesting the momentum has stalled rather than continuing. Without a clear catalyst and with the stock already extended far from prior close, the risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable — a long risks buying exhaustion at the high, while a short risks fighting an unknown fundamental catalyst.
